notes.subject: Kristy call notes — final handwritten batch
notes.body: Kristy's May 11, 2026 call sheet lists Crested Butte Wildflower Festival, 970-349-2571, and says the number needs updating / was no good. Gmail history gives the more important context: the nonprofit previously clarified that its festival is guided hikes, art workshops and botanical education rather than the kind of event Adventure Zone was seeking. Treat as not a good fit unless the event format materially changes.
